brief: Sell Claude skills as products. The new prompt economy, who's making real money, where the moats are.

slots.subtitle: How creators turn AI prompt expertise into scalable products and protect their moats.
slots.preview1: Why prompt engineers earn six figures
slots.preview2: Building productized prompt kits for startups
slots.preview3: Defending your AI moat with proprietary data

slots.title: Prompt
slots.subtitle: Companies are packaging prompt workflows as SaaS, APIs, and templates.
slots.insight1Body: Expose your best prompts via a lightweight endpoint and charge per call.
slots.insight2Body: Bundle related prompts into a purchasable kit for specific industries.
slots.insight3Body: Integrate prompts directly into user interfaces for seamless experiences.
slots.pullQuote: Your prompt is a product, not a footnote.

slots.title: Top
slots.subtitle: A handful of creators are already pulling six‑figure revenues from prompt products.
slots.insight1Body: Platforms like PromptBase enable creators to sell individual prompts directly.
slots.insight2Body: Specialized firms build custom prompt pipelines for Fortune 500s.
slots.insight3Body: New SaaS tools bundle prompt management with analytics for recurring revenue.
slots.pullQuote: The real money lies where prompts become repeatable services.

slots.title: Protect
slots.subtitle: Durable advantages come from data, workflow automation, and community lock‑in.
slots.insight1Body: Fine‑tune Claude on private corpora to create unique prompt behavior.
slots.insight2Body: Wrap prompts in CI/CD pipelines so they evolve with product releases.
slots.insight3Body: Offer tiered access to prompt libraries for paying members.
slots.pullQuote: A moat is only as strong as the data behind the prompt.

slots.title: Build
slots.subtitle: A three‑step framework to turn a prompt into a marketable product.
slots.insight1Body: Target a specific workflow where a prompt can replace manual effort.
slots.insight2Body: Create tiered pricing: free demo, paid premium, enterprise license.
slots.insight3Body: Release early, collect feedback, and refine the prompt continuously.
slots.pullQuote: Iterate on prompts like you would on code.

slots.title: AI
slots.subtitle: How a solo creator turned a Claude prompt into a $150k annual SaaS.
slots.insight1Body: Writers paid $0.10 per word for ad copy; a prompt cut time by 80%.
slots.insight2Body: Built a web UI around the prompt, charging $30 per month per user.
slots.insight3Body: Automated onboarding and added tiered plans, reaching 5,000 users in 6 months.
slots.pullQuote: A single prompt can become a multi‑million‑dollar engine.

slots.ctaBody: *Keep your prompt assets organized and monetize them before the market saturates.* Bookmark this guide as you build your first product.
